CIEEDAC (2001). Cogeneration By Region and Cogeneration By Sector, plant listings printed 27 March 2001 (14 pages each). Canadian Industrial Energy End-use Data and Analysis Centre. Author names not printed.

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. Two sorts (by region, by sector) of the same inventory of Canadian cogeneration plants: province, owner/operator, steam host, location, business type, sector, main and alternate fuel, cogeneration type (GT, ST, RE etc.), heat application, electric capacity in kW, number of units, grid connection and start year. It prints no heat output, efficiency, heat rate, cost or emissions, so no technology performance or cost record can be built. Plant-level capacity and start-year data could support a stock estimate of installed cogeneration capacity if wanted later. The two PDFs are one source (cieedac_2001_001).
